content_zh:
宁小凡前几天刚被女朋友踹了，今天打个王者荣耀，连跪了五十多把，一路从钻Ⅰ掉到青铜，郁闷得要死。
“一群坑货！”
看见对面后羿五杀绝世，宁小凡气得肝疼。
辣鸡游戏！
毁我青春！
“宁小凡，你怎么一天到晚打游戏，昨天那张数学卷子写了吗?”
这时，班委楚惜颜走过来，没好气地瞪了他一眼。
还有三个月不到就高考了，别人忙着复习刷题都来不及，这家伙还有心思打游戏。
难道他打算读完高中就辍学回家吗？
“宁小凡，虽然你现在成绩差，但你不笨的，怎么就不好好学呢？”
“三个月说长不长，说短不短，只要你下苦功去学，我相信你考个三本没什么问题的。”
楚惜颜苦口婆心地劝着。
宁小凡一边挖耳朵，一边从抽屉里掏出张雪白的卷子，“行行行，给你给你。”
楚惜颜一看，差点气背过去。
“宁小凡！你一个字没动交上来，又想被宋老师骂吗？”
“怎么一个字没动？”
宁小凡指着卷子上的姓名一栏，撇撇嘴，“喏，你看，上面不是写了本帅哥的大名吗？”
“你……”
楚惜颜差点被气晕过去。
宁小凡单手拖住腮帮子，笑嘻嘻地打量了这位美女班委一眼，“唉，小姐姐，咱班四十多号人你不管，偏偏盯着我一个。”

“老实交代，你是不是对我有意思？”
楚惜颜不仅仅是班委，班花，还是清江一中的校花。
方当韶龄，便生得清秀绝俗，端庄淑雅，白白净净的衬衫搭配学院风灰色小裙子，一头垂至腰畔的黑长直发瀑，身材纤细玲珑，婷婷玉立。
就像是从甜甜的恋爱漫画中走出来的少女。
哎，这妮子，要颜值有颜值，要身材有身材……
一道充满不屑的冷笑声，打断了YY中的宁小凡。
“呸！”
“癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉！”
一个高大英俊的青年，双手插兜，走了过来。
是班长顾天宇。
他像打量下水道里蠕动的蛆虫一般，满是优越感地道：
“宁小凡，你这个穷鬼，也敢打惜颜的主意？”
“估计连周翠都看不上你吧！”
青年脸上挂满了鄙夷和讽刺。
周翠是隔壁班的一个女生，体重两百多斤，脸上长满了痘痘和粉刺，下巴还有一块难看的胎记，常受人取笑。
“顾天宇！”
楚惜颜怒了，“你话不要说得这么难听好不好？”
她真的很讨厌这种人。
仗着自己有长相，有家世，成绩好，就不把任何人放在眼里。
顾天宇一转脸，瞬间挂满笑容，“嘿嘿，惜颜，你骂得对。”

“区区天鹅，怎么能衬托你的美丽呢？”
“应该是仙女下凡才对！”
仙女都来了！
宁小凡快被恶心吐了，“顾天宇，你听说过一句话吗？”
“什么话？”
“舔狗不得好死。”
“宁小凡，你小子找不自在是吧……”
顾天宇的脸色跟拉了灯一样，瞬间黑了下来。
他堂堂顾家大少爷，盛世财团未来的继承人，竟然被宁小凡这个乡下泥腿子形容成“舔狗”？
玛德，这里要不是学校，他顾少分分钟找人弄死这小瘪三！
“宁小凡，别以为我不敢搞你……”
顾天宇眼神阴狠，缓缓凑近宁小凡耳朵，“放学，等着，看我不嫩死你。”
“弄死我？”
“老子特么先弄死你！”
宁小凡忍这个币很久了，平日里沉积的憋屈，一朝爆发了出来！
在楚惜颜的尖叫声中，他的右拳和顾天宇的左脸来了个零距离亲密接触，猩红液体从后者鼻孔中喷出，顾天宇惨叫地倒在地上。
教室里，一片哗然！
四十多个同学都看傻了。
谁也没想到，宁小凡竟敢打顾天宇！
顾天宇他爹可是市里的集团董事长啊，身价好几十亿，平时大家巴结还来不及的呢；而宁小凡的爹，现在指不定在哪儿养鸡养鸭呢！

“啊！”
“顾……顾天宇，你怎么样？”
楚惜颜脸都吓白了。
像她这种乖乖女，哪里见识过这么暴力的斗殴。
她恨铁不成钢地瞪向宁小凡：“宁小凡！你……你太过分了，你怎么能随便打人呢，你会被学校处分的！”
“替他爹妈管教一下他而已。”
宁小凡淡淡揉了揉手背，“姓顾的，我告诉你，别以为你家里有钱，就能为所欲为！以后你惹我一次，我揍你一次！”
“好…好…宁小凡，好得很！”
“你敢打我，这事儿我记下了，回头等着！”

Ning Xiaofan was kicked by his girlfriend a few days ago. Today, he was playing King of Glory and knelt down for more than fifty times. He fell from Diamond I to Bronze. He was extremely depressed.
"A bunch of scammers!"
Ning Xiaofan was so angry that his liver ached when he saw Hou Yi's five kills.
Hot chicken game!
Destroy my youth!
"Ning Xiaofan, why are you playing games all day long? Did you finish the math paper yesterday?"
At this time, class committee member Chu Xiyan came over and glared at him angrily.
The college entrance examination is less than three months away. Others are too busy reviewing and answering questions, but this guy still has time to play games.
Does he plan to drop out of high school and go home?
"Ning Xiaofan, although your grades are poor now, you are not stupid, so why don't you study hard?"
"Three months is not a long time or a short time. As long as you work hard and study hard, I believe you will have no problem taking three exams."
Chu Xiyan persuaded her earnestly.
While picking his ears, Ning Xiaofan took out Zhang Xuebai's paper from the drawer, "Okay, okay, here it is, here it is."
When Chu Xiyan saw it, she almost lost her temper.
"Ning Xiaofan! You handed it over without saying a word, do you want to be scolded by Teacher Song again?"
"Why didn't you say a word?"
Ning Xiaofan pointed to the name column on the paper and curled his lips, "Here, look, isn't there a handsome guy's name written on it?"
"You..."
Chu Xiyan almost fainted from anger.
Ning Xiaofan held his cheek with one hand and looked at the beautiful class committee member with a smile, "Hey, little sister, you don't care about the more than 40 people in our class, but you just stare at me."
"Tell me the truth, are you interested in me?"
Chu Xiyan is not only the class committee member and class beauty, but also the school beauty of Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School.
When Fang was still young, she was born to be extremely delicate, dignified and elegant. She wore a white shirt with a college-style gray skirt. She had long straight black hair hanging down to her waist. She had a slender figure and a graceful figure.
It's like a girl who stepped out of a sweet love manga.
Hey, this girl needs good looks and good figure...
A sneer full of disdain interrupted Ning Xiaofan in YY.
"Bah!"
"The toad wants to eat the swan meat!"
A tall, handsome young man walked over with his hands in his pockets.
It’s squad leader Gu Tianyu.
He looked at maggots squirming in the sewer and said with a sense of superiority:
"Ning Xiaofan, how dare you, a poor man like you, to have an idea of Xiyan?"
"I guess even Zhou Cui doesn't like you!"
The young man's face was full of contempt and sarcasm.
Zhou Cui is a girl in the next class. She weighs more than 200 pounds. Her face is covered with pimples and pimples, and she has an ugly birthmark on her chin. She is often teased.
"Gu Tianyu!"
Chu Xiyan was angry, "Can you please stop speaking so harshly?"
She really hates this kind of person.
Just because I have good looks, family background, and good grades, I don’t take anyone seriously.
Gu Tianyu turned around and smiled instantly, "Hey, Xiyan, you are right to scold me."
"How can a mere swan bring out your beauty?"
"It should be a fairy descending to earth!"
The fairies are here!
Ning Xiaofan was about to vomit from nausea, "Gu Tianyu, have you heard of this sentence?"
"What words?"
"Licking a dog will lead to a bad death."
"Ning Xiaofan, you're feeling uncomfortable, aren't you..."
Gu Tianyu's face turned dark instantly, as if he had turned on a light.
He, the dignified eldest son of the Gu family and the future heir of the Shengshi Consortium, was actually described as a "dog licker" by Ning Xiaofan, a country guy?
Mud, if this wasn't a school, he would have found someone to kill this little brat in no time!
"Ning Xiaofan, don't think that I dare not mess with you..."
Gu Tianyu's eyes were sinister, and he slowly leaned into Ning Xiaofan's ear, "After school, wait and see if I don't kill you."
"Kill me?"
"I'm going to kill you first!"
Ning Xiaofan had endured this coin for a long time, and the grievances he had accumulated on weekdays suddenly exploded.come out!
As Chu Xiyan screamed, his right fist came into close contact with Gu Tianyu's left face. Scarlet liquid spurted out from the latter's nostrils, and Gu Tianyu fell to the ground screaming.
There was an uproar in the classroom!
More than forty classmates were dumbfounded.
No one expected that Ning Xiaofan would dare to hit Gu Tianyu!
Gu Tianyu's father is the chairman of a group in the city, and he is worth several billion. Normally, it's too late for everyone to fawn over him. But Ning Xiaofan's father, he doesn't know where to raise chickens and ducks now!
"Ah!"
"Gu...Gu Tianyu, how are you?"
Chu Xiyan's face turned pale with fright.
A good girl like her has never seen such a violent fight.
